research_projection: finite physical-entry DRAM reads, not native PTE/DMA/IOMMU or hardware clear/warm

configuration.epoch: all model clocks cold zero; accepted sends before next whole memory tick

input_acceptance: one attempt at declared tick; false/send failure invalidates case, no timing-adjustment search; all callbacks required once per accepted request
drain: only after whole GenericDRAM.tick returns: all accepted-to-this-point reads callbacked; all controllers read/write/active/priority/pending empty; no in-progress DRAM future action; every bank not Refreshing. Do not require open rows/cap/history/deadlines cleared; record readiness separately; future periodic refresh next deadline allowed. Fixed target boundary must satisfy predicate. Never certify within callback.
maintenance: record periodic enqueue acceptance, actual REFab issue for BOTH ranks, future REFab_end for BOTH ranks and post-tick bank state; completion at nRFC-1 distinct from ACT readiness nRFC
clear_warm_semantics: no invented IOTLB API; hypothetical IOTLB-only clear causes no direct DRAM state reset, elapsed ticks accounted; explicit warm is exactly listed physical reads with accepted/callback/maintenance costs, no state injection
observer: private copy only; read-only state accessors and passive command/future/enqueue events; no scheduling/state mutation. Queue/cap/next-refresh snapshots and full bank/node readiness/state at declared boundaries; compact per-tick queue/future/refresh counts for drain certification. Model truth not deployable free sensor.

controls.same_physical_trace: history_independent_replay must match history_independent_warm normalized commands/callbacks/boundary state
controls.passivity: one original-library run of history_cap_warm same driver/config/plugin physical inputs; callbacks and original TraceRecorder commands match private instrumented run
controls.matched_epochs: all five short cases target after tick256; both refresh cases after tick10000
controls.washout: cap4 close and natural completed all-rank refresh compared to fixed-time cold controls

claims_allowed: source-bound persistence or washout after certified finite read drain
conditional deterministic reconstruction given full O_phys, fixed config and public epoch, only for executed cases
claims_not_allowed: same O_phys with hidden different state
O_host is sufficient or insufficient from this alone
P/PN preference, performance or cost benefit
actual hardware sensor availability, timing, area or novelty
next_gate: if source persistence exists, define bounded joint request-action contract and observation information/cost comparison; no policy execution this iteration
stop: if drain cannot be certified or fixed times fail, report scoped failure and redesign, do not tune cases to positive
